lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: Allocated goods only. If it is not on the quarterly schedule it does not exist, and I would ask you not to describe it to me.

lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: Two shelves. Both rations. The schedule came down eleven percent and no explanation is owed to a commissary clerk.

lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: Half of this came in from outside the schedule and I have stopped filing the discrepancy. There is a clause somewhere that says people may hold things. I have read it nine times.

lines.speaker: clerk_novi
lines.text: You are the auditor who asked the question. No, I will not report it. I would quite like to know the answer.
